title: Rhythm on the lights
intro: A rhythm game on a matrix of the show: notes fall down 4 coloured lanes to the beat of a song the app makes itself, and up to 4 phones tap the matching pad when a note reaches the line. Perfect timing is 3 points, good 1, and a long run of notes in a row earns more. Alone, or friends join within a few seconds. The best scores of the day are shown on the phones. Pick the matrix, then Save.
